name: @type32/tauri-sqlite-orm
description: A Drizzle-like ORM for Tauri v2's SQL JS API plugin.

scripts.release:minor: pnpm run build && pnpm version minor --no-git-checks && pnpm publish --no-git-checks
scripts.release:prerelease: pnpm run build && pnpm version prerelease && pnpm publish
scripts.release:patch: pnpm run build && pnpm version patch && pnpm publish
scripts.update-deps: pnpm update --latest && pnpm add typescript@6.0.3 && pnpm approve-builds --all

author: Type-32
